faqHeader.title: Everything You Need to Know About Our Spaces
faqHeader.description: Find answers to common questions about the Navrachna Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development.

faqs.q: What is Navrachna Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development?
faqs.a: Navrachna Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development is a subsidiary of I.T.S. Engineering College that supports young entrepreneurs in commercializing their technologies and launching startups.

faqs.q: Who can benefit from the foundation?
faqs.a: Students, faculty, and staff looking to develop their entrepreneurial skills, test startup ideas, and connect with investors can benefit from the foundation.

faqs.q: What resources does the foundation provide?
faqs.a: The foundation offers mentorship, funding opportunities, networking support, and business development resources to help startups grow.

faqs.q: How does the foundation help bridge the gap between inventors and venture capitalists?
faqs.a: It connects innovators with industry experts, investors, and mentors to transform ideas into viable businesses.
